title: The mothership's barrier throws an item on through it
description: Behind the Alien Boss, a bomb at the foot of a shaft the player has dug breaks the rock holding the free Jetpack and blows it left. It hits the Alien Boss on its way, costing it a hit point, and reaches the barrier, which throws it on to the left, and it lands beyond the barrier, which still stands.
